body: Victor Wembanyama just had the biggest night of his NBA career. The San Antonio Spurs center scored 52 points and grabbed 24 rebounds on Nov. 4, both career highs, and added eight blocks as the Spurs held off the Dallas Mavericks 112-111.
He also made the free throw that proved to be the winning point. According to the BBC, he is the first player in 52 years to post at least 50 points, 20 rebounds and five blocks in one game.
## Why fans are buying in

Wembanyama did most of the damage early. He had 29 points, 15 rebounds and five blocks by halftime, and ClutchPoints noted that no player in NBA history had put up at least 25 points, 15 rebounds and five blocks in a single half. His previous career high was 50 points against Washington in November 2024.
The win was the Spurs' sixth straight, and they are 6-2. That follows a run to the NBA Finals last spring, when San Antonio beat Portland, Minnesota and Oklahoma City before falling to the Knicks.

His résumé keeps growing. San Antonio took him first overall in 2023, he was the unanimous Rookie of the Year in 2024, and he won Defensive Player of the Year for 2025-26 as the youngest winner ever. He was also an All-Star starter in 2026.

He is already one of the league's most popular players. Wembanyama ranked No. 4 on the NBA's list of top-selling jerseys for the 2025-26 regular season, based on online sales through the NBA Store and the Fanatics network. In our analysis, a historic night like this one only adds to that pull. This is our view, not a sales figure.
## The look
Wembanyama wears No. 1. The banner above shows his black Icon Edition jersey, the Spurs' signature look, and the white Association Edition, a clean option for home games.
## Why this jersey will last
At 22, Wembanyama is a player fans can wear for a decade, and the Spurs are built around him. A night like this one is a reminder of how high his ceiling still is.

body: Jaylen Brown is giving Philadelphia exactly what it traded for. In a 112-106 win over the Detroit Pistons on Nov. 4, he scored a season-high 30 points, 23 of them in the first half, and blocked a Cade Cunningham 3-point try in the final minute to protect the lead.
The 76ers are now 8-1, the best record in the Eastern Conference, and their only loss came against Detroit.
## Why fans are buying in

This is a fresh start for one of the league's best wings. Boston traded Brown to Philadelphia on July 1 for Paul George and four draft picks, two of them first-rounders. He arrived as the 2024 Finals MVP and a five-time All-Star, coming off a season in which he averaged a career-best 28.7 points.

He also joined a crowded star group. Joel Embiid had 26 points and 15 rebounds in Detroit, and LeBron James, in his first season with the Sixers, added 13 points, 10 rebounds and eight assists while becoming the first player in NBA history to make 16,000 field goals. Brown carried the scoring on a night when Tyrese Maxey was held to 19.
In our analysis, a new team, a fast start and a big role on a contender are the ingredients that turn a player's new jersey into a popular one. This is our view, not a sales figure.
## The look

Brown kept No. 7, the number he wore for a decade in Boston. His Sixers jersey shown in the banner above is the royal blue Icon Edition, the team's main look, with the classic Philadelphia script across the chest.
## Why this jersey will last

Brown's Celtics jerseys belong to his past; this is the first chapter of his time in Philadelphia, and the team is winning right away. If the Sixers keep leading the East, his No. 7 will be a common sight in the stands all season.

subheadline: Back from a one-game absence, Kempe scored three times and added an assist as Los Angeles beat its rival 7-2.

body: Adrian Kempe made his return count. After missing the Los Angeles Kings' previous game with an undisclosed injury, he scored three goals and added an assist in a 7-2 win over the San Jose Sharks on Nov. 4 at Crypto.com Arena.
His first goal came on a breakaway just 83 seconds in, and he finished the hat trick before the end of the second period.
## Why fans are buying in

It was the fifth hat trick of Kempe's NHL career, which ties him with Charlie Simmer and Jimmy Carson for ninth in Kings history. It was also his 37th multigoal game with the franchise, moving him past Dustin Brown into ninth place on that list.

Kempe has been a Kings player from the start. Los Angeles drafted him 29th overall in 2014, and he grew into one of the team's top scorers, with a career-best 41-goal season. In November 2025 the Kings signed the Swedish winger to an eight-year, $85 million extension that runs through 2033-34, so he is part of the long-term plan.

The night also showed the help around him. Artemi Panarin had four assists, Quinton Byfield scored twice on the power play, and Darcy Kuemper made 30 saves. The Kings are 5-7-2, and the win came at the start of a seven-game homestand, a stretch that gives them a chance to climb in the Pacific.
In our analysis, a homegrown scorer who is signed long term is one of the safest jerseys a fan can buy, because he is not going anywhere. This is our view, not a sales figure.
## The look
Kempe wears No. 9. His jersey shown in the banner above is the Kings' black home look, with the silver and white trim that has defined the team for decades.
## Why this jersey will last

With his contract running into the next decade, a Kempe jersey bought now should stay current for years. A big night against a rival is a good reminder of why he has become a fan favorite in Los Angeles.
